detail_of_failure: Fine control performance or response is unsatisfactory.
related_information: Pre-troubleshooting If a failure code is shown, do the troubleshooting for that code first. Monitoring code • F pump pressure can be examined with the monitoring function. (Code: 01100) • R pump pressure can be examined with the monitoring function. (Code: 01101)

steps.procedure: 1. Examine the inside of pump servo equipment. 2. Are the orifice and filter not clogged and clean?

branches.YES: • The servo piston is correct. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • The servo piston is defective. • Repair or replace the servo piston. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: 1. Stop the engine. 2. Connect all the component parts. 3. Start the engine. 4. Operate the lever to do the troubleshooting. 5. Do the work equipment, swing and travel operate normally?

branches.NO: Go back to the first check item.
